title: A nonlinear problem related to optimal insulation
summary: We study a generalization of the classical optimal insulation problem by replacing the standard Laplacian with the \ti{p-Laplacian}, leading to a \ti{p-Poisson equation} with Robin boundary conditions. We also investigate the corresponding eigenvalue problem. This work extends and complements some results from \cite{bu1,pietra1,pietra2} to the nonlinear setting.
